title: Garden DesignFest: Mornington Peninsula gardens
summary: Visit designer gardens on the Peninsula on 21-22 November, 10am-5pm. Choose your stops from the organiser's garden directory and check entry arrangements before travelling.
venueName: Participating gardens across Mornington Peninsula Shire
verificationNote: Programme dates and hours checked against the organiser on 17 November 2026. Single organiser provenance chain; independent editorial review and release acceptance are separate. Individual-site arrangements, admission and availability are not verified.
editorNote:
Garden DesignFest opens designer gardens across Melbourne and the Mornington Peninsula on 21-22 November 2026. This listing covers the Peninsula gardens only. The organiser's current directory lists gardens in Merricks, Mount Martha, Mornington, McCrae, Rye, Merricks North and Blairgowrie.

Use the garden directory to choose a manageable route and check each garden's address and entry arrangements. The programme hours are 10am to 5pm on both days. These are separate gardens, not a single festival site or an invitation to arrive at a regional map pin. Check the organiser for current ticket details and any changes before setting out.
provenance: Original PI editorial draft from current organiser information. Held for regional discovery support, independent exact-candidate review and rendered release checks. No automated scan or publication receipt claimed.
